entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, VeloFit agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. The sizing chart is a complete lie and this is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with the fit. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?

It's VF-8675309. I've been a VIP customer for years, and I've never had an issue like this. This Aero Race jersey is just absurdly too tight. It's the wrong size entirely, even though I followed your guide!

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you bringing this to my attention. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on December 29th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference on the fit?

Are you listening? It's the wrong size because your company can't make a proper sizing chart! I want to return it or get an exchange. If this doesn't get sorted out right now, I'm taking this to social media and I want to speak to your manager.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can certainly handle this for you. I apologize again for the inconvenience. Let me just confirm our current return policy for this item.
There's nothing to confirm! Just process the return. I'm not wasting my whole day on this.
Of course. One moment... Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you immediately.
Well, finally. So what's next? Don't make me pay for shipping.

Not at all. I've just processed the return authorization and a pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email right now. And since you're a valued VIP customer and had such a poor experience with the sizing of that jersey, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 store credit to your account. You can use that on a future purchase, perhaps for the next size up on that exchange.
Oh. A credit? Okay... well, that's... that's actually helpful. I appreciate that. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you get the gear that fits you perfectly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. I'll look for the email.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
